svg.aria-label: KYC records are proved locally into a bundle of zk-STARK proofs: the kycHash root goes on chain, and a counterparty checks claims such as over 18, approved jurisdiction or professional client without ever seeing the underlying values, while an append-only signed registry answers what was true at a past block.
svg.text: Append-only signed registry — root anchors · list versions · revocations
one Merkle root over every field
Entitled at block N: YES / NO
